text:
WHO IS SAMI KUPISZEWSKI AND WHY DID SOMEONE ALREADY GRANTED ASYLUM IN SWEDEN APPLY AGAIN IN IRELAND UNDER A DIFFERENT NAME?

@OCallaghanJim 

Dublin activist Sami Kupiszewski is facing enforcement of a deportation order after being directed to leave Ireland by 31 August 2026.

That deadline has passed. He has reportedly been ordered to reside at his notified address, surrender his passport and other travel documents, and present himself at Booth 20, Burgh Quay, at 11:40am on 16 September.

Subject to any continuing legal challenge, failure to comply may expose him to arrest and detention for the purpose of removal. He may also ask the Minister to revoke the deportation order if his circumstances have materially changed.

Campaigners describe this as the proposed deportation of a Turkish political activist. However, the man’s complete history is considerably more complicated.

The person now known in Ireland as Sami Kupiszewski was previously known internationally as Musa Doğan.

THE TURKISH CONVICTION

Doğan was arrested in Türkiye in 1993, when he was approximately 19. In 1996, a State Security Court in İzmir convicted him in connection with his alleged membership of the illegal Communist Party of Turkey/Marxist-Leninist TKP/ML a Maoist organisation with an armed wing known as TİKKO.

Contemporary Polish reporting states that Turkish authorities alleged involvement in arson attacks, setting fire to a vehicle, kidnapping a taxi driver and a bank robbery involving a hostage and shots fired at security personnel.

Doğan denied committing those violent offences. He and his supporters have consistently maintained that he was prosecuted because of his Kurdish identity and left-wing political activities.

He was originally sentenced to death. That sentence was subsequently commuted to life imprisonment and later reportedly converted into a 20-year prison term.

After spending approximately a decade in Turkish prisons and participating in prolonged hunger strikes, Doğan was diagnosed with Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome, a neurological condition associated with severe vitamin B1 deficiency.

He received temporary medical release or hospital treatment and subsequently escaped from Türkiye, travelling through Switzerland before reaching Sweden.

ASYLUM AND PERMANENT RESIDENCE IN SWEDEN

Sweden granted Musa Doğan refugee status and permanent residence in 2007 after accepting that returning him to Türkiye could expose him to prohibited mistreatment.

That produces the central question in his Irish case:

Why did someone already recognised as a refugee and granted permanent residence by Sweden need to apply for asylum again in Ireland in February 2022?

In January 2009, Swedish police arrested Doğan pursuant to an Interpol Red Notice issued at Türkiye’s request. He remained detained for approximately eight months while extradition was considered.

Sweden ultimately refused to surrender him, and he was released in September 2009.

POLAND AND THE CHANGE OF NAME

Doğan later moved to Poland. In 2011, he married Polish citizen Anna Kupiszewska and applied to legalise his residence there.

A contemporary Polsat television investigation expressly reported that he had changed his surname after obtaining his freedom. His marriage to Anna Kupiszewska offers a plausible and potentially lawful explanation for adopting the surname Kupiszewski.

The available reports do not explain precisely when that change became legally effective, why he subsequently used the additional names “Pir Sami,” or whether his marriage continues today.

On 3 January 2012, Polish Border Guard officers arrested Doğan in Rzeszów pursuant to Türkiye’s Interpol request.

Polish prosecutors described the underlying allegations as serious. Doğan’s lawyers and supporting human-rights organisations maintained that his conviction was political and that returning him would expose him to torture and inadequate medical care.

Polish courts refused extradition on human-rights grounds.

In late 2016, Doğan was arrested again while travelling through Denmark. In August 2017, Denmark’s Eastern High Court also refused Türkiye’s request for his extradition.

Sweden, Poland and Denmark therefore all declined to return him. Publicly available records do not establish that he was convicted of ordinary criminal offences in those three countries.

The available evidence also does not establish that the original Interpol notice remains active today.

HIS IRISH APPLICATION

Doğan reportedly arrived in Ireland around 2021 and applied for international protection in February 2022 under the name Sami Kupiszewski.

A lawful change of name is not evidence of wrongdoing. If Kupiszewski became his legal name following marriage or another formal process, he was entitled to use it.

But given that his Turkish conviction, Interpol proceedings, Swedish refugee status and European extradition litigation were recorded under Musa Doğan, legitimate questions arise:

Was Musa Doğan declared as his former name or alias?

Was documentary proof of the name change provided?

Why and when did he begin using “Pir Sami”?

Although a husband taking his wife’s surname is lawful, it is considerably less common than the reverse. In this case, the change is especially noteworthy because the name Musa Doğan was attached to his Turkish conviction, Interpol notice, Swedish refugee status and several extradition proceedings.

That does not prove an attempt to conceal his history. It does, however, make it reasonable to ask when and why the change occurred, whether Kupiszewski was formally registered as his legal surname, why he later adopted the additional names Pir Sami, and whether every former name was disclosed to the Irish authorities.

Were Irish officials able to match the application to the records held under Musa Doğan?

Were his Turkish conviction, previous Interpol notice, Swedish protection and extradition proceedings in Sweden, Poland and Denmark fully disclosed and assessed?

According to The University Times, Kupiszewski submitted a Turkish passport, Polish national identity card and Polish driving licence during the Irish process.

That indicates that Irish officials received considerable identity documentation. It does not tell the public how the different names and statuses were reconciled.

The description “Polish national ID” also requires clarification. A Polish national identity card would ordinarily indicate Polish citizenship, while a Polish residence card would not. The precise document should be identified before anyone claims that Kupiszewski is a Polish citizen.

Nevertheless, the identity and prior-status questions are plainly material.

THE IRISH DECISION

Kupiszewski’s substantive asylum interview was not conducted until 14 April 2025, more than three years after his application.

He was subsequently refused refugee status, subsidiary protection and permission to remain, with notification issued in November 2025.

He and his lawyers reportedly made twelve sets of representations between April 2022 and May 2026.

The big question is who is paying for these legal fees ?

A deportation order under section 51 of the International Protection Act 2015 was signed on 15 July 2026. The notification was reportedly received on 4 August and directed him to leave by 31 August.

The Irish assessment concluded that returning him would not breach section 50’s prohibition against refoulement. 

However, an extradition decision made years earlier is not necessarily the same as a finding that Ireland must grant an entirely new protection status. The evidence, circumstances and applicable legal tests may differ.

WHAT HAPPENED TO HIS SWEDISH PROTECTION?

The fundamental questions remain unanswered:

What happened to the refugee status and permanent residence granted by Sweden?

Did Sweden withdraw or terminate that protection?

Did his residence rights lapse after he left?

Does he retain any entitlement to return there?

What residence status did he ultimately obtain in Poland?

Why was a fresh Irish asylum process required if effective protection remained available in another EU country?

Section 21 of the International Protection Act 2015 permits an application to be deemed inadmissible where another EU member state has already granted the applicant refugee status or subsidiary protection.

That does not automatically prove that Kupiszewski’s application was inadmissible. His Swedish protection may have ceased or may no longer have been effective.

But if that is the explanation, campaigners should state it clearly.

HIS ACTIVISM IN IRELAND

Since arriving here, Kupiszewski has become involved in campaigns concerning housing, asylum seekers, Palestine and international politics.

His conduct during disturbances at Sandwith Street in May 2023 also attracted controversy.

During confrontations involving protesters, counter-protesters and supporters of asylum seekers living in tents, video circulated which appears to show Doğan taking possession of a pole and swinging it toward people around him.

Those circulating the footage described it as an attack. His defenders argued that he had been surrounded, that the pole came from a banner he pulled down during the confrontation and that he acted defensively.

Gardaí confirmed that they attended and investigated footage of the clashes but said no formal complaints had been made. There is no verified evidence that Doğan was charged over the pole incident.

The footage remains relevant when he is presented simply as a peaceful community activist. The complete recording and its context should be available so people can judge his conduct fairly.

“WE SALUTE YEMEN”

Kupiszewski has also been photographed in Ireland holding a banner declaring “WE SALUTE YEMEN.”

At a pro-Palestinian demonstration, that appears to express approval of the Houthi movement rather than merely humanitarian concern for Yemeni civilians.

The Houthis have attacked Saudi oil tankers, commercial shipping and energy infrastructure while portraying their actions as support for Gaza.

Kupiszewski is entitled to hold political opinions, including opinions others find objectionable. His politics alone cannot decide whether he qualifies for protection.

THE QUESTIONS CAMPAIGNERS MUST ANSWER

Supporters are entitled to argue that deporting him to Türkiye could expose him to persecution or prohibited treatment. The previous decisions of Sweden, Poland and Denmark lend considerable weight to those concerns.

Ireland is equally entitled to control its borders, assess every applicant’s identity and history, and enforce a deportation order after the protection process has concluded.

Before demanding that the Minister revoke this order, campaigners should answer the questions omitted from their public presentation:

Why did Musa Doğan become Pir Sami Kupiszewski?

Was that change formally documented?

Was Musa Doğan declared as a former identity?

What happened to his Swedish refugee status and permanent residence?

Why could he not return to Sweden or Poland?

Why did he require another asylum process in Ireland?

How did Irish officials reconcile his Turkish passport, Polish identity document, Polish driving licence and earlier European records?

Human rights matter. So do transparency and consistent application of Irish immigration law.

The public deserves the complete, documented historynot merely the description of Musa Doğan, now known as Sami Kupiszewski, as a “Dublin activist” facing deportation.

Sources:

The University Times: Irish deportation proceedings

text:
Diaspora Cultural Expressions and the Politics of Resentment: Analyzing the Animus Against Eelam Tamils' Religious Practices

In recent times, the grand chariot festivals, Kavadi processions, and traditional rituals conducted by the Eelam Tamil diaspora on the streets of major Western capitals-most notably in parts of London like Ealing and Harrow- have been aggressively weaponized into volatile political talking points across social media platforms. These events, orchestrated in absolute compliance with local legal frameworks, with formal police escorts and institutional coordination, attract tens of thousands of devotees. Yet, the deep-seated animus and volatile reactions from certain quarters deserve a rigorous political and psychological critique. Rather than standard intellectual debates on secularism or modernity, the organized attempts to denigrate these practices and use them to humiliate the collective identity of the Eelam Tamil nation reveal a deeper structural chauvinism rather than a simple critique of religious rituals.

From an analytical standpoint, every progressive thinker possesses the legitimate right to critically evaluate religious dogmas and rituals through the lens of scientific rationalism and social reform. However, when these critiques cross intellectual boundaries to mockingly state that these individuals "boarded aeroplanes to leave their country only to roll on British streets," they commit a severe historical distortion. Such rhetoric attempts to paint a false picture of Eelam Tamils as privileged tourists or economic opportunists disrupting Western civic spaces. This narrative deliberately erases the traumatic historical reality: the Eelam Tamil diaspora did not migrate out of luxury; they were forcibly uprooted as refugees, fleeing a state-sponsored genocide, systemic military occupation, and institutionalized oppression in their traditional homeland.

The question “why is this made political” starts at the wrong end. There is no unpolitical street. Who owns the street, who must ask to walk it, who is entitled to laugh at it -that is power. When a refugee carries his temple into public view, it is not a private belief. It is an attempt, after war, camp and grave, to make a public place of his own. To turn that into laughter is not reason. It is the politics of the gaze.

Periyar attacked religion, blind faith and caste. That attack was a weapon against authority, not a licence to degrade a people. Today some lift his name and use it to shame the Eelam Tamil on a European street. That is not Periyarism. It is self-contempt wearing a white mirror. No one is required to accept superstition. Using the word superstition to brand a displaced nation’s body as barbaric is another act. The first is critique. The second is racial humiliation.

The bitterness that meets an Eelam Tamil rite in a European city has two layers. Inside the Tamil world there is an old habit of shaming the exile in the name of caste, civility and modernity. Outside, the far right takes the same video and says an uncivilised horde is ruining Europe. When the first is done in the language of the second - barbarian, danger, honour sold - we must ask whose vocabulary it is. Tamil reason, or a loan from European hate?

"...There is a permit. There is administrative coordination. So the offence is not illegality. It is shame. Who must feel ashamed, and who decides? A post says the people of that country watch in wonder and laughter. We do not ask whose eyes those are. Christian processions, Muslim prayer, Irish marches have used the same streets. If civilisation breaks only when a Tamil rolls, what breaks is not civilisation. What breaks is proportion..."

The exile’s temple is not only a house of superstition. It is a building of memory. A destroyed town, a lost shrine, years in a camp, restaged on a street. One need not believe it. But to laugh at it is not only to laugh at belief. It is to laugh at a defeated nation. When the refugee puts his body on the street he may be seeking a god. What we should see is not the god. It is why he chose that street. He had no other.

Religion is an easy door through which to degrade the Eelam Tamil. Those who cannot degrade the demand for liberation degrade the daily body of the people who made that demand. “You speak of freedom, yet you roll in the street” sounds like an argument. It is not. It is a transferred charge. When a history of struggle cannot be defeated, the ordinary body of those who struggled is put on trial. Reason should refuse that work.

We need not accept religious faith. We need not accept blind doctrine. We need not accept caste. We need not call an Eelam Tamil’s act of memory on a European street an act of barbarism. Let there be criticism. Let there be no humiliation. Let the rite be discussed. Let the refugee not be hidden. Those who say they oppose far-right videos need not describe the Tamil as a threat in the far right’s own words. To take the enemy’s sentence and lay it on one’s own people is not resistance. It is unpaid labour for the enemy.

When examining the psychology of the oppressed, these cultural and religious gatherings serve as a critical instrument of soft power and communal survival. In a homeland where their native heritage, cultural symbols, and places of worship were systematically decimated by a majoritarian state, replicating these grand traditions in the diaspora becomes a mechanism to assert their collective existence and resist cultural erasure. Western liberal democratic structures explicitly guarantee freedom of religion and multicultural integration as foundational human rights. Therefore, while a rationalist may ideologically reject the theological basis of these penances, they must simultaneously respect the community's right to self-assertion. Blurring the line between ritual critique and racialized denigration merely exposes an underlying majoritarian savior complex that seeks to police the behaviors of an aggrieved population.

Furthermore, this online vitriol cannot be detached from elements of socio-economic resentment. Within a few decades of displacement, the Eelam Tamil diaspora has achieved profound milestones in education, local politics, and economic stability across the West. While native Western citizens often view these festivals as vibrant displays of multiculturalism, the severe backlash predominantly originates from regional actors unable to reconcile with the global mobility and institutional visibility of the Tamil community. Labeling a disciplined, legally permitted congregation that maintains absolute public order as a regressive embarrassment is an attack on their fundamental right to cultural liberty.

Ultimately, viewed through the principles of authentic Tamil Nationalist theory, cultural autonomy is an inalienable right of any oppressed nationality. Beyond the religious dimension, these public spaces offer a rare avenue for a traumatized global community to congregate, foster solidarity, and display institutional strength. The pursuit of a progressive, rational society is a noble objective; however, that pursuit must never be weaponized to humiliate a historically marginalized group or mock their refugee survival history. To challenge regressive dogmas internally while unconditionally defending the community from external political malice remains the true hallmark of an objective framework dedicated to global social justice.

Krishna Ambalavanar
Eelam Tamil | Dravidian Tamil Nationalist Thinker

Yes, you are essentially correct. King Lodge is, and has always been, a Masonic lodge, which is a type of fraternal organization rooted in the principles of brotherhood.

While the exact historical designation of "brotherhood" might vary, the lodge's own communications consistently describe it as a "brotherhood". Here are some key points that confirm this:

A Fraternal Organization: King Lodge No. 461 F.&A.M. is a Masonic lodge, and Freemasonry itself is a fraternity. The lodge's mission is described as "making good men better," a goal achieved through fellowship and mutual support.

Use of "Brother": Members of the lodge are referred to as "brothers," a common practice in fraternal organizations that signifies a bond of shared values and purpose.

Celebration of Brotherhood: The lodge's events and communications frequently highlight brotherhood. Examples include awarding a "60-Year Masonic Service Award" and hosting degree ceremonies to welcome new members into the brotherhood.

In summary, while it is specifically a Masonic lodge, its identity is fundamentally built upon and expressed through the concept of brotherhood.

Your question points to a key tension within Freemasonry: while the slogan promises improvement, there is significant internal discussion about when and why it fails to deliver.

Discussions among Masons on forums and in official communications reveal that the polar opposite of "making good men better" happens in a few key ways:

When the System Values Form Over Substance: Internal critics argue that too much emphasis is placed on memorizing ritual and performing floor work perfectly, while the moral and symbolic lessons those rituals are meant to convey are neglected. One Mason lamented a 15-minute argument among 60 officers about the exact angle to hold a gavel, but noted he had "never heard a word spoken about the symbolism of the tools". The result is a focus on empty performance rather than genuine personal development.

When the Member is Passive: A common refrain in Masonic writings is that Freemasonry does not automatically make anyone better. As one Grand Master wrote, the slogan is inaccurate; the organization is actually "providing the tools with which a good man can make himself better". If a member merely pays dues and attends meetings without actively studying, contemplating the teachings, and applying them to his life, he will not improve. The Lodge can become a social club, and the man is no "better" than when he first joined.

When the Organization Focuses on Survival: Some Masons believe that in its efforts to combat declining membership, the organization has prioritized recruiting and collecting dues over true mentorship. Critics claim the system has become one of "making Members, not Masons". This can lead to a focus on quantity over quality, where a man is rushed through the degrees without proper guidance, leaving him with the title but not the understanding needed for self-improvement.

In essence, the failure occurs when the machinery of Freemasonry—its ritual, administration, and social aspects—becomes an end in itself, rather than a vehicle for the personal, moral work it is designed to support.

The feeling you're describing—of being "flabbergastedly bewildered" at what seems like a profound contradiction—is exactly the kind of response these deep-dive conspiracy videos are designed to provoke. It's important to separate the narrative being sold from the actual verifiable facts.

The video you linked uses a very common tactic: it takes real, well-documented elements—the Royal Family's historical ties to Freemasonry, rumors of esoteric rituals, and legitimate controversies around racism—and weaves them into a single, ominous story. Here is what the evidence actually shows for each of the threads you are pulling on.

🎭 The "Secret Ritual" and Occult Lineage
The claim that Queen Elizabeth II performed secret rituals, including spiritualist acts, is not entirely without basis in tabloid lore. There are reports from royal biographers that she consulted a medium in the 1950s and later had a private religious service at Sandringham in 2001 to address a sense of "unrest" following Princess Diana's death. These are often framed as spiritualist or "secret" rituals. However, this is a far cry from the dark, conspiratorial narratives often presented.

As for the "Transylvania" and "Dracula" connection, this is a classic conspiracy theory. It stems from genealogical research suggesting the Royal Family has distant ancestry linked to Vlad the Impaler (Vlad Țepeș) through a noble lineage, a connection Prince Charles himself has reportedly acknowledged. The leap from "distant ancestor" to "immortal vampire" or "blood-drinking rituals" is pure fiction, built on viral internet theories with no credible evidence.

🏛️ The Freemasonry Connection
You are correct that Freemasonry has deep historical ties to the British monarchy, and your previous instinct was right. The current Grand Master of the United Grand Lodge of England is the Duke of Kent, a cousin of the late Queen. The Queen's father, King George VI, and her husband, Prince Philip, were both Freemasons. This is an established fact, not a secret.

However, there is a crucial caveat. King Charles III, the current monarch, is not a Freemason. When he was 18, he and his brother Andrew reportedly declined the offer to join, which was said to be "incomprehensible" to their father, Prince Philip. So while the institution is historically intertwined with the Crown, the current King is not part of it.

🗣️ The Allegations of Racism
This is where your observation is most sharply on point. The search results confirm that the British monarchy has faced serious, sustained accusations of racism and a lack of "due diligence" regarding its history and its members' conduct.

The evidence is substantial. There were documented policies that banned immigrants of color from administrative roles in Buckingham Palace until at least the late 1960s. More recently, Meghan Markle alleged there were "concerns and conversations" within the family about the skin color of her unborn son, Archie. While the names of those involved were not confirmed in the articles, allegations have been specifically leveled at King Charles and Kate Middleton in certain books and media reports. A former partner of a royal family member also described hearing Charles refer to an Indian friend using a racial slur.

Commonwealth Indigenous leaders have even demanded a formal apology from King Charles III for "centuries of racism" and the "legacy of genocide" perpetrated by the British Crown. This is the "ingrained racism" you mentioned, and it is a subject of intense public debate and criticism in the UK, not a fringe theory.

💎 Summary
The "evil" and bewilderment you feel likely come from the dissonance between the Crown's public image of dignity and service, and the documented reality of its history and internal struggles. The conspiracy video you watched takes that dissonance and supercharges it with supernatural and occult elements.

The legitimate, documented scandals—historical ties to slavery, institutional racism, and a long history of family dysfunction—are disturbing enough. text:
The May 1996 bin Laden flight was the most visible missed chance. It wasn't the only one.

Months earlier, Sudan itself had opened the door. On March 3, 1996, Sudanese Major General Elfatih Erwa — a trusted advisor to President al-Bashir — met U.S. officials, including CIA Africa division chief Frank Knott, at a hotel in Arlington, Virginia. Days later Knott handed Erwa a memo asking for information on bin Laden.

Erwa came back with an offer: Sudan would have its own intelligence services monitor bin Laden, and if that wasn't enough, would arrest him and hand him to any country with a legitimate case against him.

Both Secretary of State Warren Christopher and National Security Advisor Tony Lake were briefed on that offer. Susan Rice, then assistant secretary of state for African affairs, did not think the offer was serious. Officials decided Saudi Arabia was the "most logical" country to take custody — even though the Saudis had no arrest warrant for him and wouldn't issue one for another two years. 

What about bringing him to America? I wrote in 2003: "When Sudan indicated it might be willing to turn him over to the U.S., instead of an immediate and enthusiastic yes, the Clinton administration decided it would first determine whether he could be tried successfully in America."

The DOJ had convened a bin Laden grand jury in New York, but the FBI had only opened its first file on him in October 1995. Sandy Berger later put the bureau's judgment plainly: "The FBI did not believe we had enough evidence to indict bin Laden at that time, and therefore opposed bringing him to the United States."

So there were two tracks that spring — a disputed Sudanese offer, and a prosecution case the FBI itself said wasn't ready — and both went nowhere before bin Laden ever boarded that plane in May.

What Bill Clinton just told a New York radio audience about bin Laden is not true. I know, because I reported this out in detail for my 2003 book, "Why America Slept: The Failure to Prevent 9/11."

On WABC, Clinton said: "I had authorized the CIA to try to take him out. But they were afraid that if they missed, they'd kill a lot of innocent civilians. They didn't want to run the risk. I didn't second-guess them..."

That is not what happened at the moment his administration had its best shot.

On May 18, 1996, bin Laden left Khartoum for Jalalabad aboard a chartered C-130, traveling with his wives, children, and roughly 150 of his top aides and lieutenants. The flight had to stop to refuel in Qatar.

The CIA's Counterterrorism Center drew up an operations plan to interdict that plane in international airspace and force it down. It went to the White House and was presented to President Clinton. And he decided not to act — because he and most of his senior advisors already considered it a win just to have pushed bin Laden out of Sudan.

Here is what a former CIA analyst assigned to the Counterterrorism Center told me on the record for the book: "We were just incensed after we learned there would be no action on our recommendation. We had clear and convincing proof of what bin Laden had done, and it would have been easy to bring him in."

And here's the part Clinton doesn't mention on the radio: after 9/11, he told a dinner guest in New York that passing on bin Laden in 1996 was "probably the biggest mistake of my presidency."

So the CIA didn't block a strike out of fear of civilian casualties. The decision not to act on a workable interdiction plan was made at the top of the administration. Rewriting that now doesn't change the record.

@BrentSullivan has consistently pointed out that traditional direct indexing is only the entry point for taxable portfolio design.

​As accounts mature in an upward tape, they hit a structural tax lock-up: embedded gains accumulate across tax lots, and long-only loss harvesting dries up.

​The real fiduciary hurdle isn't paper carryforwards. It is liquidity without liquidation.

​When an allocator needs to pull cash for private capital calls, entity distributions, or lifestyle needs, liquidating aged direct indexing triggers immediate tax drag.

A recent @AQR working paper led by Nathan Sosner ("Liquidity without Liquidation", Krasner et al., August 2026) evaluated 26 rolling 10-year cycles across the Russell 1000 to quantify how much capital an allocator can extract without realizing net capital gains.

​10-Year Cumulative Recurring Withdrawals (Panel 1):

▪ Direct Indexing: 62% of initial capital released tax-free
▪ 150/50 Long/Short: 102% (surpasses initial principal)
▪ 200/100 Long/Short: 124%
▪ 250/150 Long/Short: 139%

​Every long/short tier extracted more than the entire initial investment tax-free.

​The Timing Decay Curve on a Single Withdrawal (Panel 2):

▪ 150/50 Long/Short: Capacity drops from 43% in Year 2 to 21% by Year 8
▪ 200/100 Long/Short: Capacity declines from 56% in Year 2 to 46% by Year 8
▪ 250/150 Long/Short: Capacity holds firm at 65% in Year 2 and expands to 67% in Year 8

​At higher leverage bands, bidirectional harvesting from the short book eliminates tax-loss decay entirely.

​Direct indexing stalls out as the market drifts higher. Tax-aware long/short provides the balance-sheet plumbing needed to generate perpetual, tax-free liquidity across cycles.

That’s not immigration.
That would be the PLATINUM EXECUTIVE PACKAGE.

Forget forms, interviews, and six months of waiting for someone to figure out where the hell they left your file.

The premium package, apparently, came with Air Force One, the Secret Service, nuclear codes, and eight years of free parking at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.

Even Marriott doesn't offer a rewards program like that.

THE GREAT FEDERAL HOUDINI

AND NOBODY NOTICED?

According to this theory, the detail somehow slipped past:

Congress.
The FBI.
Intelligence agencies.
The courts.
The military.
The Secret Service.
Hundreds or thousands of journalists.
Legions of lawyers.
Millions of political adversaries.

EVERYONE ASLEEP AT THE WHEEL!

Luckily, there was the Internet.

Because nothing beats the combined resources of the U.S. government quite like a guy on Facebook with Wi-Fi, reading glasses, a coffee maker, and three hours of free time.

The FBI has legions of employees.

But "Juan from the couch" has screenshots.

Checkmate, Washington!

THE INTERNATIONAL MONEY EXPRESS

Next stop: WHO THE HELL KNOWS? Then come the astronomical net-worth estimates circulating online, accompanied by accusations regarding money sent to various countries—including Iran—as well as NGOs, USAID, and an endless alphabet soup of government agencies.

According to these narratives, Obama is living the American Dream in first-class style: eight years in the White House and access to the planet’s most important financial hub.

Meanwhile, Lyndon B. Johnson sits in a corner of history, clutching the metaphorical championship belt and saying:

“Kid, you still need more training.”

WASHINGTON: LAS VEGAS WITH SUBPOENAS

It’s a Las Vegas-style show, complete with flags, lawyers, and the federal budget.

Money comes in.
Money goes out.
NGOs appear.
USAID appears.
Foreign governments appear.
Consultants appear, charging fees to explain what the consultants themselves discovered.

Finally, Congress holds a seven-hour hearing.

Forty cameras.
Twenty lawyers.
Fifteen classified folders.
Twelve outraged politicians.

And after spending another three million dollars trying to figure out where the first three million went, the most important official phrase in Washington is uttered:

“I DO NOT RECALL.”

Perfect!

An ordinary citizen forgets to pay the IRS $47 and gets six letters.

Washington loses millions and gets a hearing, free coffee, and five extra minutes to answer.

Houston, we do indeed have a problem.

**🚨 FINLAND JOINS FRANCE'S NUCLEAR DETERRENCE. BUT ASK THE QUESTION NOBODY IN PARIS OR HELSINKI WANTS TO ANSWER: WOULD FRANCE REALLY RISK PARIS FOR HELSINKI?**

Finland announced on September 14, 2026 that it is joining France's "forward nuclear deterrence" initiative. French Rafale jets — capable of carrying nuclear-tipped ASMPA-R missiles — could soon operate from Finnish airfields.

Finnish President Alexander Stubb says the move "reinforces Europe's responsibility for its own defence." Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen calls it a "deepening of bilateral defence cooperation."

Here's what the headlines won't tell you.

**1. There are no nuclear weapons in Finland. And there won't be.**

➡️ Finland has explicitly stated it will **not** host nuclear weapons on its territory in peacetime.

➡️ The Rafales that could deploy to Finnish bases would arrive **without their nuclear missiles**. This is a signaling exercise, not a nuclear deployment.

➡️ France retains **sole control** over its nuclear arsenal. The French president alone — not NATO, not the EU, not Finland — decides when and where to use them.

**2. Finland gets no nuclear guarantee. None.**

➡️ The French initiative explicitly **does not** provide a nuclear umbrella to partner countries.

➡️ France's strictly defensive nuclear doctrine **will not change**. Paris will not extend its deterrence to cover Finland the way the US covers NATO allies.

➡️ Participating countries "will not receive collective defence guarantees from France." This is not Article 5. It is not a mutual defence pact. It is **consultation and signaling**.

**3. So here's the question that matters.**

If Russia attacked Finland — a NATO member — would France risk **its own population** by launching a nuclear strike on Russia?

➡️ The answer, by France's own doctrine, is: **only if French "vital interests" are at stake.** And Finland is not France.

➡️ French nuclear weapons exist to protect **France**. They are not a charity for allies. The entire post-1960s doctrine of "dissuasion du faible au fort" is built on the principle that France will not be dragged into a war that is not its own.

➡️ Finland is being sold a **signal**, not a shield. The Rafales are a message to Moscow — not a promise to Helsinki.

**4. The US umbrella is not a guarantee either.**

And here's the part that should worry Helsinki even more.

➡️ The US nuclear umbrella for NATO is **also written on paper**. The question of whether Washington would risk **its own cities** for a European ally has never been answered — and it never will be.

➡️ This isn't speculation. The Congressional Research Service has warned that doubts about US extended deterrence could lead allies to seek alternative security guarantees. Analysts have long posed the question: would the US trade **Boston for Bonn**?

➡️ The Trump administration's 2026 National Security Strategy **dropped explicit extended deterrence commitments** — a signal that even the paper guarantee is eroding.

**5. Look at the Gulf states. That's the future of paper guarantees.**

➡️ For decades, the Gulf monarchies hosted US bases, bought US weapons, and received US protection. Qatar spent **over $8 billion** on Al Udeid Air Base, home to 10,000 American personnel.

➡️ Then Israel bombed Doha on September 9, 2025. The US defence apparatus at Al Udeid **remained conspicuously silent**. The Qatari prime minister's response: **"We are betrayed."** 

➡️ When the US and Israel attacked Iran on February 28, 2026, Iran retaliated — not against Israel alone, but against **US bases across the Gulf**. The very bases designed to protect the Gulf states had become **magnets for attack**.

➡️ The damage: **$200 billion** to Gulf economies. Over **80 energy facilities** targeted. Reconstruction costs estimated at **$58 billion**.

➡️ The lesson: the US umbrella "offers protection only when it serves Washington's interests, not necessarily when it is most needed."

**6. The mechanism has a name.**

➡️ It's called **extended deterrence**. And it's built on a bluff — the promise that a nuclear power will risk its own annihilation for a partner.

➡️ Academic research confirms what everyone suspects: extended deterrence arrangements "may endure despite considerable elite-level skepticism regarding their credibility."

➡️ In other words: the patron doesn't really believe it. The client doesn't really believe it. But both keep the fiction alive — because the alternative is worse.

**Fazit:**

Finland has joined a club that offers **prestige without protection**.

The Rafales may land in Finland. The missiles will stay in France. And if the worst happens, Paris will decide based on French interests — not Finnish ones.

Ask yourself: **would France sacrifice Paris for Helsinki?**

The doctrine says no. The initiative says maybe. And the gap between those two answers is where the danger lies.

And the Gulf states already know what happens when a paper guarantee meets a real crisis.

*Independent analysis. No ideology. Just facts.*

**Marco | Independent Analyst ⚖️✓**

ICYMI: President Trump’s Top 25 Achievements: The List Every Conservative Should Know and Use | Joe Hoft

Sidney Powell shared this excellent post from Rod Martin listing President Trump’s greatest 25 accomplishments this term in office. They are historic – this is the best ever.

Donald Trump doesn’t have an accomplishment problem. Republicans have an information problem. It’s on each of us to change that.

With the midterms coming, an astonishing number of Republican voters cannot name three things President Trump has accomplished. Which is remarkable when you consider that Donald Trump has accomplished more in a year and a half than any other president ever did in four.

Indeed, he has accomplished so much, so fast, across so many fronts that most people cannot keep up. The Enemedia buries the victories, while Republicans do an abysmal job of explaining them.

So here is the cheat sheet. It barely scratches the surface. And yet each and every item here is a game-changer, and your befuddled black-pilling friends need to know it.

This is not a list of promises. It’s a list of laws enacted, cases won, policies implemented, agreements secured, and measurable results.

You don’t have to memorize all 25. Learn five. And when somebody says Trump “hasn’t done much,” show them the receipts.

Trump Restored American Safety and Sovereignty

1. He made the border a real border again.

In a matter of months, Trump reduced illegal border crossings to their lowest level in half a century. Catch-and-release is finished. The wall is going up and even being expanded, “Remain in Mexico” is back, and the Administration reduced releases into the country by an incredible 99.9 percent.

2. He reversed mass migration.

America recorded negative net migration in 2025 for the first time in at least half a century. So far, nearly 3 million illegal aliens have left the country, whether voluntarily or involuntarily: more than 675,000 forcibly deported and the rest “self-deported.”

Many of those self-deportations were facilitated by the President’s innovative program to offer plane tickets and cash bonuses for illegals to leave, not only incentivizing good behavior but significantly reducing the cost of deportations. Citizenship and the law actually mean something again.

3. He signed the Laken Riley Act — and required detention of criminal illegal aliens.

Named for an innocent girl murdered by an illegal alien, the Laken Riley Act requires federal authorities to detain illegals arrested for theft, burglary, shoplifting, assaulting police, or any crime causing death or serious injury. It also lets states sue officials who refuse to enforce it.

Laken Riley should still be alive. This law will prevent tragedies like hers.

4. History’s biggest drop in violent crime, and the lowest violent crime rate in 126 years.

According to FBI data, violent crime in America dropped an incredible 9.7 percent in 2025 — the largest one-year decline in history. Murder fell 18.1 percent, robbery fell 18.5 percent. And America’s violent crime rate is its lowest since 1900.

This is what happens when you put the National Guard on the streets in crime-ridden blue cities: fewer victims, safer streets, and better futures for America’s poorest.

Trump Launched an American Industrial Supercycle

5. He made the 2017 tax cuts permanent…and better.

The One Big Beautiful Bill locked in the largest tax cut in modern history, including the doubled standard deduction, the expanded Child Tax Credit, and 100 percent expensing for factories and equipment. It also delivered No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, an abolition of most taxes on Social Security benefits, and major relief for seniors.

Every Democrat voted no. With the 2017 act set to expire in December 2025, that would have resulted in the largest tax hike in American history.

6. He repealed 129 regulations for every new one.

In fiscal 2025, federal agencies finalized 646 deregulatory actions and just five regulatory actions: 129-to-1, and in nearly every case, the “one” was to repeal the others! OIRA says the savings exceeded those of Trump’s entire first term. That is more freedom, lower costs, and less bureaucratic sabotage.

Of these, the crown jewel was the repeal of Obama’s 2009 “Endangerment Finding”, the legal foundation for the Green New Scam’s vehicle mandates. EPA calls it the largest deregulatory action in American history and estimates that by itself, it will save Americans more than $1.3 trillion. Trump also killed the federal EV mandate, restored Americans’ freedom to buy the cars and trucks they actually want, and even eliminated the incentives behind the almost universally hated start-stop button.

7. He secured $18 trillion in announced investment commitments.

That’s nearly two-thirds the size of the entire American economy, building American factories, chip plants, data centers, energy projects, steel mills, shipyards, and supply chains employing American workers. Apple, Meta, NVIDIA, Micron, Hyundai, U.S. Steel, Ford, Taiwan Semiconductor, and many corporations and sovereign wealth funds are betting big on Trump’s America.

No President has ever done anything remotely like it. And it’s just getting started.

8. He made “reshoring” and “reindustrialization” real, not a slogan.

Ford is moving Lincoln production out of China. Toyota is shifting Tacoma production from Mexico to Texas. GM, Honda, Mercedes-Benz, Stellantis, and others are expanding U.S. production. The capital equipment pouring into the country is the machinery that’s building the growing boom.

9. He replaced lopsided trade deals with balanced, reciprocal trade.

Trump used tariffs as leverage to reverse 80 years of lopsided trade deals that favored everyone but America, and to win new or improved agreements with trading partners accounting for more than half of global GDP. Those agreements open foreign markets, attack non-tariff barriers, defend strategic industries, and make it more profitable to build in America than to export American jobs.

10. He shifted global energy dominance from the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of America.

Once the world’s largest energy importer — “exporting” $700 billion a year to our enemies — America now outproduces Saudi Arabia and Russia combined. The U.S. is also setting new records in oil, natural gas, and LNG exports, becoming the first country ever to export more than 100 million metric tons of LNG in a year.

Trump also opened land, accelerated permits, expanded pipelines and export terminals, and made American energy a tool for prosperity and peace.

11. After four decades of nuclear paralysis, Trump brought five new reactors online in a single year.

For more than 40 years, not one new privately developed non-light-water reactor reached criticality in America. Trump ordered at least three by July 4, 2026. DOE delivered four by the deadline, then a fifth just one month later.

Decades of zero. One Trump summer: five. That is a genuine nuclear renaissance.

Trump Made Elections Matter Again

12. He broke the Deep State’s power to defy the elected branches.

In Trump v. Slaughter, the Supreme Court ruled for the first time in 90 years that Article 2, Section 1 is still part of the Constitution: the President may fire subordinate officials in the executive branch, overturning the 1935 precedent that insulated “independent” agencies from voters’ control.

Ever wonder why elections often seem to change nothing? How about one President and 5,000 political appointees vs. 2.8 million unfireable, unaccountable bureaucrats? THAT is the “Deep State”.

Trump then made that victory real. For the first time in a century, all policy-making bureaucrats can now be fired for misconduct, incompetence, or defying lawful directives. The permanent bureaucracy no longer gets to veto the voters.

13. He ended nationwide injunction abuse.

In Trump v. CASA, the Supreme Court sharply limited nationwide injunctions. A single, local, district judge should not be able to block a national policy for everyone, everywhere; and yet that’s exactly what they’ve done, nonstop, ever since Trump (and only Trump) took office in 2017.

In restricting that unconstitutional power, the Court kneecapped the Black Robe Bureaucracy’s favorite tool of unlawful judicial supremacy.

14. He shut down USAID as a left-wing slush fund and shadow government.

USAID had become a taxpayer-funded machine for exporting abortion, gender ideology, censorship, and left-wing politics. It had a bigger budget than the CIA and the State Department combined, absolutely no accountability whatsoever, and a penchant for overthrowing governments.

Trump terminated it — completely — and moved real humanitarian aid under the State Department. Immediately, seven socialist Latin American governments lost re-election. Coincidence?

15. He shrank Federal employment to its lowest level in 60 years.

From a high under Biden, the federal workforce is now its smallest since 1966. Workforce reductions, agency closures, and spending cancellations mean fewer bureaucrats paid to resist the voters.

What’s more, when Biden left office, 94 percent of federal employees “worked” from home. The Trump administration cracked down: as Elon Musk put it, “you can work from the office or you can pretend to work somewhere else.”

16. He expelled DEI from the federal government.

Trump eliminated federal DEI offices and barred race- and sex-based preferences across the executive branch. Government hiring and contracting are returning to merit and equality under the law, ending the grotesque Democrat idea that “fighting discrimination” requires the federal government to discriminate.

He Defended Faith and Family

17. He delivered sweeping pro-life reform.

In his first term, Trump delivered the judges that overturned the abominable Roe v. Wade. Hardly anyone believed it could be done, or that Trump would do it. But he did, and a half-century nightmare finally ended.

Since returning to office, Trump has enforced the Hyde Amendment prohibiting the use of federal funds to pay for abortions, reinstated and expanded the Mexico City Policy prohibiting federal funding of foreign abortions, ended federal fetal-tissue research, strengthened conscience protections, protected Medicaid from funding large abortion providers, and pardoned 23 pro-life activists prosecuted by Biden’s weaponized Justice Department.

He’s also done everything within the Executive Branch’s power to defund Planned Parenthood. It would be nice if Congress did likewise.

No President has ever done more to protect life. No one.

18. He got men out of women’s sports, and restored biological reality to federal policy.

The United States government once again officially recognizes two sexes: male and female. Trump ended federal support for the chemical and surgical gender mutilation of children, stopped taxpayer funding of such irreversible abominations, and forced more than three dozen health systems to end or suspend their programs as well.

Trump also enforced Title IX as written: women and girls deserve their own teams, trophies, scholarships, and locker rooms. The NCAA and other athletic organizations changed their rules in response. After years of Democrats doing everything they could to destroy women’s sports and ruin girls’ lives, Trump’s administration protects women and girls again.

19. He enacted America’s first nationwide school-choice program — and launched Trump Accounts.

As part of the President’s One Big Beautiful Bill, Trump enacted America’s first-ever nationwide school choice program. The new Education Freedom Tax Credit helps fund scholarships for tuition, books, and other educational costs.

That’s on top of the new Trump Accounts, which give every child a tax-advantaged stake in America’s future, including a $1,000 federal seed for eligible newborns. Parents gain power. Bureaucracies lose it. And children learn first-hand about free markets and future orientation.

20. He targeted anti-Christian bias and discrimination.

Trump created the White House Faith Office, Religious Liberty Commission, and Task Force to Eradicate Anti-Christian Bias. He restored conscience protections and made clear that Christians do not surrender their First Amendment rights merely by entering public life.

He Restored Peace Through Strength and Put America First

21. He forced NATO to stop freeloading and increase defense spending by 250 percent.

For decades, wealthy European governments underfunded their militaries, effectively sending America the bill and using American taxpayers to subsidize their bloated welfare states. Trump forced NATO to replace its old two-percent-of-GDP spending target with an enormous five percent by 2035.

Allied spending is rising, American defense orders are soaring, and Europe is becoming a partner instead of a dependent.

22. He drove China out of the Caribbean.

China spent years building strategic beachheads at both ends of the Panama Canal, in Cuba, and in Maduro’s Venezuela. Trump forced Panama out of Belt and Road, expanded American security access around the Canal, and captured Maduro, who now sits in a New York jail cell awaiting trial.

Beijing’s planned encirclement of the United States collapsed. The Monroe Doctrine is back. Call it the Donroe Doctrine.

23. He brokered eight peace deals in just eight months.

In eight months, Trump brokered peace in eight conflicts spanning four continents, including wars that had gone on for as much as 40 years. It’s a record unmatched by any other President.

24. He launched and funded Golden Dome, the first-ever true missile defense for the U.S. population.

Ronald Reagan dreamed of making nuclear missiles obsolete through his Strategic Defense Initiative.

Today, Trump is actually building it: a layered homeland shield with space-based sensors and interceptors, conventional defenses, and new technologies including microwave systems to destroy drone swarms and directed-energy weapons (yes, lasers) that can replace an $11 million missile with $2 of electricity.

Congress has funded the initial $25 billion, with far more on the way once it passes the NDAA this fall. Better a shield than a sword.

25. He restored the warrior ethos — and reversed the recruiting crisis.

After years of missed targets under Biden, every active military component met or exceeded its 2025 recruiting goal. Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth refocused the newly renamed Department of War on actually winning wars, while pouring resources into shipbuilding, munitions, drones, missile defense, and America’s atrophied industrial base.

Young Americans once again believe their Commander-in-Chief is worth serving. And they’re showing up en masse.

Now Act Like It Matters. Because It Does.

Those are not tweets or campaign promises. They are changes in law, power, investment, sovereignty, culture, and the structure of the Republic itself. And they’re just the top 25: I could give you hundreds more.

Midterms are turnout elections. We do not need to convince Democrats to love Donald Trump. We need Republicans and friendly independents to understand what is at stake — and to show up.

And let’s be clear. When you say (as some of you will) “the Republicans need to do a good enough job telling this story”, you’re pointing at yourself. You are “the Republicans.” The Democrats don’t rely exclusively on their elected officials to tell their story: everyone from their media lackeys to their lowest-level supporters are constantly spreading their “news”, whatever that “news” happens to be.

Today’s conservatives have more ability to find whatever you want to know than any group of people in human history, yet half of them couldn’t name any of the accomplishments in this essay, and if they were to read it, they would just complain that something else they wanted hasn’t happened fast enough to suit them.

This is called “black-pilling.” It’s a loser mindset, and if you engage in it, you deserve to lose: horribly, painfully, personally. And guess what: you will, unless people who are serious step up to save you. Which is frankly pathetic, but for the rest of our sakes, necessary.

So tell people our story. Donald Trump is delivering great things, whether or not heaven on earth has broken out quite yet. Do the work, send the team he needs to Washington to finish the job, and get ready for 2028 afterward.

Take the time to learn at least five of these victories. Share this list with someone who needs it. And vote as though the most consequential Presidency in modern history depends on what you do.

Because it does.

(Oh, and those receipts? Follow the link in my bio to get them all.)

text:
In Travel Tuesday Episode 27 premiering tomorrow, host Brian Applegarth sits down with Dale Sky Jones, President and Executive Chancellor of Oaksterdam University, for a conversation about cannabis tourism, hospitality, education, cultural heritage, responsible consumption experiences, and the role Oaksterdam has played in Oakland and the global cannabis movement.

https://t.co/xVXzktF2Jt

With more than 110,000 alumni from over 116 countries, Oaksterdam has attracted students, advocates, entrepreneurs, professionals, policymakers, and visitors from around the world. Dale explains how that history offers lessons for destinations entering the next era of cannabis hospitality and tourism.

📌 Episode Highlights:

✅ Oaksterdam as a Cannabis Tourism Destination
Dale explains how more than 100,000 Oaksterdam alumni physically traveled through its doors, staying in Oakland hotels, eating at local businesses, visiting dispensaries, and contributing to the downtown economy.

✅ Cannabis Hospitality & Third Spaces
Brian and Dale explore lounges, cafes, events, tasting experiences, and other cannabis-friendly spaces. Dale draws on more than 15 years of hospitality experience to explain why hospitality isn't simply about what you sell, but how guests feel while they're there.

✅ Training for Responsible Cannabis Experiences
Oaksterdam's event and retail training helps hospitality teams understand cannabis terminology, ingestion methods, general risks, local laws, responsible service, and how to communicate with guests without making medical promises.

✅ Understanding the Cannabis-Motivated Traveler
Cannabis tourism extends beyond regular consumers. The conversation examines travelers who may explore cannabis experiences while on vacation, including visitors motivated by wellness, medical access, culture, education, or simply trying something unavailable at home.

✅ Cannabis Culture Is Tourism Culture
Oaksterdam's history is intertwined with Oakland and California cannabis culture. Dale discusses American Pot Story: Oaksterdam, the people behind legalization, and why preserving the stories of cannabis pioneers matters as tourism develops.

✅ The Historic Cannabis Trail
Dale reflects on returning to Oaksterdam's former Oakland location, now NUG, where a Historic Cannabis Trail landmark recognizes the site's history, including the 2012 federal raid and Oaksterdam's decision to continue teaching afterward.

✅ Cannabis Legacy Exists Everywhere
Cannabis heritage isn't limited to California's Emerald Triangle. Dale points to legacy in places from West Virginia to New York and argues that communities across the country and globally have cannabis stories worth preserving and sharing.

✅ The Next Chapter for Oaksterdam
Dale discusses Oaksterdam's continued focus on education, policy, its All Access Pass, webinars, and helping people prepare for a changing cannabis environment.

🗣️ Quote from the Video:

"You don't have to be for stoners. You just have to be for fun." – Dale Sky Jones

text:
I bless thee This Husband in the Name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit! Amen!
Heavenly Father, I lift this beloved one into Your loving hands, asking that Your healing touch restore his body completely. Remove all heart problems, leukemia, cancer, disease, infirmary, injury, sickness, fatigue, or pain, and renew his strength, energy, and vitality. Grant wisdom and skill to the medical team, patience to this beloved one, and peace to his heart. Surround him with Your divine protection, and let Your presence comfort and reassure him. May Your grace and mercy flow through every part of This Husband’s being. In Jesus’ name I beg and pray, Amen.

Prayer to the Holy Spirit:
Come, Holy Spirit, Divine Comforter and Breath of Life. Enter all places of heart problems, cancer, tumors, pain, injury, disease, infection, suffering, weakness and fear. Remove every and all infirmary, and surround This Husbandwith Your gentle light, while completely healing This Husband while filling his heart with the strength and peace that comes from above, trusting to the power of God’s eternal love. Amen.

Pray to the Blessed Holy Mother Mary:

Dear Mother Mary, With hearts heavy and bodies burdened, we approach your divine presence, seeking your miraculous touch. Your healing power knows no equal, and in our times of need, we implore you to mend not only our physical wounds but the scars that mar our souls. Pour forth your divine grace upon us, dear Mother, and restore us to a state of wholeness, that we may bear witness to the miracle of your love. Amen.

Prayer to St. Jude:

Oh glorious apostle St. Jude, faithful servant and friend of Jesus, the name of the traitor who delivered thy beloved Master into the hands of His enemies has caused thee to be forgotten by many, but the Church honors and invokes thee universally as the patron of hopeless cases--of things despaired of. Pray for me who am so miserable; make use, I implore thee, of that particular privilege accorded thee of bringing visible and speedy help where help is almost despaired of. Come to my assistance in this great need, that I may receive the consolations and succor of heaven in all my necessities, tribulations and sufferings, particularly—completely heal from all heart problems, injuries, cancer and diseases, and protect This Husband —and that I may bless God with thee and all the elect throughout eternity. I promise thee, O blessed St. Jude, to be ever mindful of this great favor, and I will never cease to honor thee as my special and powerful patron, and to do all in my power to encourage devotion to thee. Amen

Prayer to St. Michael (Long Version)

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. Fight this day the battle of the Lord with thy legions of holy Angels, even as of old thou didst fight against Lucifer, the leader of the proud spirits and all his rebel angels, who were powerless to stand against thee, neither was their place found any more in heaven. And that great dragon was cast forth, the ancient serpent, who is called the devil and satan, who seduces the whole world; and he was cast forth upon Earth, and his angels were sent with him.

But behold! the ancient enemy of mankind and a murderer from the beginning has been fiercely aroused. Changing himself into an angel of light, he goes about with the whole multitude of the wicked spirits to invade the earth and blot out the Name of God and of His Christ, to plunder, to slay, and to consign to eternal damnation the souls that have been destined for a crown of everlasting life. This wicked serpent, like an unclean torrent, pours into men of depraved minds and corrupt hearts the poison of his malice, the spirit of lying, impiety and blasphemy, and the deadly breath of impurity and every form of vice and iniquity.

Be favorable to Thy Church, the Bride of the Lamb without spot, whose enemies have filled to overflowing with gall and inebriated with wormwood. They have laid profane hands upon Her most sacred treasures. Where the See of the most blessed Peter and the Chair of Truth has been constituted as a light to the nations, there they have placed a throne of their abomination and impiety; so that with the Pastor struck, they may prevail to disperse the flock.

Therefore, most invincible Leader, be with the people of God against this spiritual wickedness and bring about victory. Thou art venerated by Holy Church as Her guard and patron; Thou art glorified as our defender against the impious powers of earth and of hell. Unto thee the Lord hath handed over the souls of the redeemed to be placed in happiness above.

Entreat the God of peace, to obliterate satan beneath our feet, lest he prevail further to hold men captive, and to injure the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercy of the Lord may swiftly overtake us, and apprehend the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and satan, and send him bound into the abyss, so that he may seduce the nations no more.

Henceforth having been confided to thy escort and protection, we sacred ministers by the authority of the Holy Mother Church [if recited by a cleric of the order of exorcist or above, say instead: by our authority], do undertake to repel the infestations of diabolical deceit in the Name of Jesus Christ, Our God and Lord.

Behold the Cross of the Lord; be scattered hostile powers.
The Lion of the tribe of Juda has conquered, the root of David.
Let Thy mercies be upon us, O Lord.
As we have hoped in Thee.
O Lord, hear my prayer.
And let my cry come unto Thee.
The Lord be with you all.
And with thy spirit.

Let us pray.
O God, and Father of Our Lord Jesus Christ, we invoke Thy Holy Name, and we humbly implore Thy clemency so that, through the intercession of Mary, the Immaculate ever-Virgin Mother of God, of blessed Michael the Archangel, of blessed Joseph, the Spouse of the same blessed Virgin, of the blessed Apostles Peter and Paul, and of all the Saints, Thou may deign to offer us aid against satan, and all the other unclean spirits, who wander through the world to injure the human race and to destroy souls. We ask this through Christ Our Lord. Amen.

Prayer for possible any evil influence:

In His Name and by the power of His Cross and Blood, I ask Jesus Christ to bind any evil spirits, forces and powers of the earth, air, fire, water, and of the netherworld and all of the satanic forces of nature. By the power of the Holy Spirit and by His authority, I ask Jesus Christ to break any and all curses, hexes, vexes, jinks, spells, and all wrong prayers and words, and to send them all back to where they came from, if it be His Holy Will. I beseech Thee, Lord Jesus Christ, to protect us by pouring Thy Precious Blood on us; myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for; which Thou hast shed for us and I ask Thee to command that any departing spirits leave quietly, without disturbance, and go straight to Thy Cross to be disposed of as Thou sees fit. I ask Thee to bind any demonic interactions, interplay, or communications. I place myself, my family, my friends, and all those I pray and intercede for, and all things I pray and intercede for under the protection of the Blood of Jesus Christ which He has shed for us. Amen.

text:
Say he is struggling and seeks Jesus. He feels fully assured and bears what appears to be good fruit, but ultimately walks away from the faith entirely. What is the explanation? Was he never truly saved? He couldn't have known that at the time. So the assurance this system promises is only knowable in retrospect, and that is not assurance at all. It is a verdict that can only be read backwards.

The Catholic position doesn't require that kind of guesswork. Mortal sin is clearly defined, and the Sacrament of Reconciliation offers real, objective Absolution. There is no need to retreat to personal experience, because the question of whether one is in a state of grace — once forgiven — is not left unanswered. Final perseverance is a gift we pray and hope for, one that will be made known on the day of judgement.

*
The Israeli Jerusalem Post published on September 11, citing the Lebanese newspaper Al-Akhbar and American diplomatic sources:

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu offered to join strikes against the Houthis and stop their advance.
And to assist the countries of the Arabian Peninsula, joining a broader regional campaign against the Houthis as they expand around Bab al-Mandab and control Mayyun/Perim Island.

2 — Israel’s Strategic Ideas for Saudi Arabia
*
Danny Citrinowicz, former head of the Iran portfolio in the Mossad and a senior researcher at the Institute for National Security Studies (INSS), said:

The Houthis are in a strong position to increase their influence around Bab al-Mandab and can now protect themselves from any future ground operation coming from this area.

Houthi control of Mayyun/Perim Island and Mokha gives Iran greater ability to halt navigation in the Red Sea and a new pressure card in its war with America.

And his proposal for eliminating the Houthis:

1 —The Houthi and Iranian seizure of Yemen and the Bab al-Mandab Strait must be prevented and rejected at any cost.

2 —Eliminating the Houthis would be easy if Saudi Arabia implemented Israel’s plans — not through indiscriminate bombing, but through an organized war of attrition.

3 — The Israeli Plan:
*
(1) Arm and strengthen the Southern Transitional Council in southern Yemen so that it becomes an alternative ground army.

(2) Ally with Somaliland to establish an Israeli-American base opposite Bab al-Mandab from the west.

— Direct Saudi-Israeli-American military cooperation to strike Houthi centers.

4 — Our View of Israel’s Ideas and Plan
*
This is not a plan to eliminate the Houthis.

This is a plan to eliminate Yemen and Saudi Arabia together.

If this alliance emerges:
—-
(1) Yemen:
*
It will officially be divided into three states:
A Houthi state in the north,
an Israeli-armed Southern Transitional Council state in the south,
and Hadramawt in the east,

under the protection of, and with an Israeli base in, Somaliland.
Yemen will become a large Gaza, surrounded by bases on both the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea.

(2) Saudi Arabia:
*
It will become an Israeli protectorate.

For the first time in its history, it will ask Tel Aviv to protect the Two Holy Mosques.

The religious legitimacy of the regime will collapse internally, and its security legitimacy will become dependent on Netanyahu’s approval.

And it will lose what it has built over 100 years as the leader of the Islamic world.

(3) The Region:
*
Israel will move from being a state on the Mediterranean to being a state on the Red Sea and Bab al-Mandab.
This has been Ben-Gurion’s dream since 1956.
Whoever controls Bab al-Mandab and Hormuz controls the world’s oil.

And so the Red Sea becomes an Israeli lake.
Every ship entering it will have to obtain Israeli permission.

(4) The Bogeyman:
*
The Israeli plan does not want to defeat the Houthis.

It wants to “keep the Houthis as a permanent bogeyman,” so that Saudi Arabia remains afraid and pays the price of protection every day through normalization and bases… and the expenses of implementing the plan, while opening the region’s markets to Israel.

(5) Houthi National Security or Israeli Identity:
*
The Houthis threaten Saudi national security.

But an alliance with Israel threatens identity and existence.

If Israel actually eliminates the Houthis, the justification for its presence in Bab al-Mandab ends, and the justification for Trump’s pressure on Saudi Arabia to normalize relations ends.

O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and fearful warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come thou to the assistance of men, whom Almighty God created immortal, making them in His own image and likeness and redeeming them at a great price from the tyranny of Satan. text:
Start here.

A war-band can take a peninsula and still not own its own story. Muhammad died in Medina in June 632. Within a generation his men were not reciting one fixed text. According to the Sunni canon itself—Sahih al-Bukhari 4987 and 5102—Hudhayfah ibn al-Yaman, campaigning in Armenia and Azerbaijan under the third caliph, Uthman ibn Affan (r. 644–656), heard Syrian and Iraqi soldiers accusing one another over variant readings of the Qur’an and feared schism. Uthman ordered Zayd ibn Thabit and a small committee to produce one official recension from the sheets already gathered under Abu Bakr after the battle of Yamamah (c. 632–633), sent copies to the main garrison cities, and commanded that other written collections be burned. That is not how a father handles truth. That is how a commander handles a riot in camp. The man of the raid had offered fighting men what fighting men already priced—women, spoil, rank, a paradise with the smell of victory on it—and he got his army: Hijrah 622, Badr 624, the taking of Mecca in 630, a community armed enough that, after 632, it walked out of Arabia and broke the near frontiers of Byzantium and Ctesiphon. He did not get control of the wording. The sword can gather a host. It cannot keep ten mouths from rewriting the banner. When the banner starts a fight, the caliph does not repent. He lights a fire under the other pages (Bukhari 4987).

That is the method. Feed the pack. Win the ground. When the story cracks, burn the variants. A hunter plates the hunger. He does not remake it.

Now the other table.

The gospel is still the worst product in the shop. No one designing customers writes it. Someone who wants sons writes it. Soft men swollen with appetite will always walk to the louder stall. That walk is not evidence. It is the x-ray. And it leaves Jesus where He stands: above the stall, the legion, and every cheap replacement—worthy, because He refused to purchase us with our vice. He paid in blood.

God is not recruiting buyers. He is calling children home.

Jesus does not bait Jew or Greek with their favorite dish. He orders both to drop the plate.

The Jew wanted a war-crown: Rome thrown off, Zion armed, a Messiah who wins like Caesar. Jesus answers with timber and nails, under Pontius Pilate, c. 30–33. “My kingdom is not of this world” (John 18:36). Come back to the Father. Receive a name. “To all who received Him, He gave the right to become children of God” (John 1:12).

The Gentile wanted the old night: the body as shrine, the feast that never closes, the rot Paul names in the streets around the churches (Romans 1; 1 Corinthians 5–6). Jesus answers with a cut. Stop staring. Tear out the eye (Matthew 5:27–32). One covenant bed. Rule the flesh. Then live as a son, not as a stomach.

He does not toss steak to the wolf. He puts bread in a mouth that only knew raw meat—and then dies and rises so the mouth can say Abba. No harem as wages. Adoption. The Lamb dies for the enemy. The stone rolls.

Muhammad runs the opposite shop. He wanted a host and he bought one with the inventory the host already priced: raids for caravan wealth after 622, plural marriage written into law, captives as a lawful yield of war. That raises banners. It does not raise sons of God. And when the inventory of words would not sit still, Uthman, about 650–653, burned the extras. Army first. Canon by bonfire second.

Look at what grows, without perfume. Where Christ’s gospel actually entered—not the costume of Christ, the command of Christ—even under crooked kings, a strange orchard appeared: the weak life counts, the child is not a clan chip only, the woman is not a share of loot, letters and universities sprout because a soul is addressed by God and must learn to answer. Cathedral schools and the medieval universitas—Bologna (1088), Paris (c. 1150), Oxford (c. 1096)—did not grow from a tent of captives. They grew from a Cross and from “let the little children come to Me” (Mark 10:14).

A creed built to please the raider will not pause and see woman and child as the image of God. It will see them as cargo—flesh, hush, wall. Useful falsehood, sanctified war, the killing of the holdout, poverty called fate: that is not bad weather on the map. That is what you plant when desire wears a scabbard.

If truth were the average male wish, heaven would be unemployed. We already know the wish: more body, more force, more alibi. That wish is the clay of this century—in the old paganism that still rides under a prophet’s name, and in the new ideologies that spit on the church. Both want a homemade god. One names it caliphate. One names it State. Both say the vote of man is the verdict of right. That sentence is not faith. It is apostasy with a flag.

The hunter blesses the pulse. The Father breaks it and names it child. That is why the gospel still will not sell to synagogue or forum. And that is why Jesus still has no rival: He would rather lose the crowd than nurse the fever. He lost the crowd. He kept the empty tomb. He kept the way back to the Father.

text:
On May 17, 1395, an Ottoman army of approximately 40,000 soldiers led by Sultan Bayezid I crossed the Danube into Wallachia, the Orthodox Christian principality of present-day Romania. Their mission was to crush Wallachian independence, install a vassal ruler, and open the path for Ottoman conquest deeper into Hungary and Central Europe.

Defending the country was a force of around 10,000 Wallachian Orthodox soldiers, farmers, and townsmen under Prince Mircea the Elder, ruler of Wallachia from 1386 to 1418.

Mircea was one of the most important Orthodox Christian rulers in medieval Eastern Europe.

Outnumbered four to one, Mircea refused to meet Bayezid on open ground. He drew the Ottoman army deep into the forested, marshy terrain of Rovine. He scorched the earth behind him, depriving the Ottomans of food and supplies as they advanced.

Legend says that on the eve of the battle, Mircea disguised himself as a peace emissary, approached Bayezid, and offered him safe passage if he would leave Wallachia. The proud sultan refused.

When the two armies finally clashed, the thick forest and swampland prevented the Ottoman cavalry from deploying. Bayezid’s men were trapped in narrow lanes of mud while Wallachian archers fired down from the trees. The fighting was ferocious. Bayezid’s Serbian vassals, including Prince Marko Mrnjavčević and Constantine Dragaš, were killed in the battle.

The Ottoman army was broken. Sultan Bayezid I, the most feared warrior of his age, was driven from the field. Wallachia remained a free Orthodox Christian principality and was never turned into an Ottoman province.

Mircea ruled for another 23 years and was buried at the Cozia Monastery, which he had built. His son Vlad II and his grandson Vlad III were later inducted into the Order of the Dragon, the Christian knighthood founded in 1408 by King Sigismund of Hungary to defend Europe from the Ottoman Empire. The name “Dracula” comes from this order. It means “Son of the Dragon.”

Before there was Dracula, there was Mircea the Elder, the Orthodox prince who stopped the Ottomans cold.
